description: Quick fix for an INTERNAL repo (HQ or StudioControlRoom; app repos use quick-fix): branch studio/{{slug}} from origin/main → build (local, agent from the Team: line of the intake file) → QA (local) → review (Opus + Codex) → PR, auto-merged per policy with merge-pr.js. Vars: workdir (checkout), slug, idea (intake file), repo (owner/name).

stages.run: node -e "if(!['chalupuh/AIDevCompanyHQ','chalupuh/StudioControlRoom'].includes('{{repo}}')){console.error('quick-fix-internal only supports chalupuh/AIDevCompanyHQ or chalupuh/StudioControlRoom; use quick-fix for app repos');process.exit(1)}"
git fetch origin && git switch -c studio/{{slug}} origin/main

stages.task: Quick fix. Implement exactly what the intake file {{idea}} asks for (only that, small and focused), using the Team role named in it; follow its rules. Run the repo's checks before finishing.

QA the quick fix {{slug}}: check the change against the acceptance criteria in {{idea}}. Follow your 'Pipeline runs' protocol (report file first). Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.qa.md ending with a line 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'VERDICT: FAIL'.

Review the whole diff of branch studio/{{slug}} against origin/main in {{workdir}} for the fix described in {{idea}}. Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.review.md ending with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

Review the whole diff of branch studio/{{slug}} against origin/main in {{workdir}} for the fix described in {{idea}}. Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.review-codex.md ending with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

stages.run: git add -A && git commit -m "fix: {{slug}}" && git push -u origin studio/{{slug}} && gh pr create --repo {{repo}} --fill && node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const n=cp.execFileSync('gh',['pr','view','studio/{{slug}}','--repo','{{repo}}','--json','number','-q','.number'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();process.exit(cp.spawnSync('node',['{{home}}/tools/ci/merge-pr.js','{{repo}}',n,'--wait'],{stdio:'inherit'}).status===0?0:1)"
